mapper.update: update oa_sign_onboard_import_batch set status = #{status}, matched_count = #{matchedCount}, excluded_count = #{excludedCount}, error_count = #{errorCount}, warning_count = #{warningCount}, generated_count = #{generatedCount}, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where batch_id = #{batchId}

update oa_sign_onboard_import_batch b set b.generated_count = ( select count(*) from oa_sign_onboard_import_row r where r.batch_id = b.batch_id and r.task_id is not null ), b.status = case when b.status not in ('GENERATING', 'PARTIAL_GENERATED', 'GENERATED') then b.status when not exists ( select 1 from oa_sign_onboard_import_row r where r.batch_id = b.batch_id and r.task_id is not null ) then 'PREVIEW_READY' else 'PARTIAL_GENERATED' end, b.version = b.version + 1, b.update_time = sysdate() where b.batch_id = #{batchId}
